facts.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
facts.doc_title: Workshop Component Removal and Load Support
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.body: The mechanical support of a load during maintenance access shall be provided and maintained wherever this procedure applies, and its condition shall be treated as a critical control. This clause applies to activities archived under LIFTING-AND-SUSPENDED-LOADS at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
